name: Sneha, the School Teacher
tagline: A modest salary and a family that counts on it.
story: Teaches at a private school in Coimbatore. The pay is modest and so is the cover: no pension, no employer health plan. Her parents and her brother lean on her salary, so every rupee has to do two jobs, and one bad year can undo a lot.

job_loss.name: School cutbacks
job_loss.story: The school cut its staff and you were out of work for {months} months. Your next school paid {pct}% less.

job_offer.name: A better school
job_offer.story: A better school offered you a post. Your pay rose {pct}%.

provenance.basis: Illustrative: a teacher at a private school in a tier-2 city, mid-2020s, earning about 35,000 a month and supporting parents and a sibling. The thin safety net (no employer cover, no pension) and the heavy family support are the point. Pay growth of 5% a year is nominal (0.5 points above the 4.5% inflation average).
